mcqs.question: Which project was launched in Rayalaseema on 22 May 2026 as the first project under the Andhra Pradesh Integrated Clean Energy Policy–2024?
options: Adani Hydro Energy Eleven Ltd.’s project
Solar ingot-wafer manufacturing project at Anakapalli
mcqs.explanation: SAEL Industries’ 600 MW solar project was launched in Rayalaseema on 22 May 2026 as the first project under the Andhra Pradesh Integrated Clean Energy Policy–2024. Gandikota-II is a separate pumped storage project, while solar ingot-wafer manufacturing is associated with Anakapalli.

mcqs.question: To which company was the 2,250 MW Gandikota-II pumped storage project in YSR Kadapa allotted?
options: Andhra Pradesh Integrated Clean Energy Policy–2024
mcqs.explanation: The 2,250 MW Gandikota-II pumped storage project in YSR Kadapa was allotted to Adani Hydro Energy Eleven Ltd. SAEL Industries is associated with the 600 MW solar project launched in Rayalaseema.

mcqs.question:
With reference to Andhra Pradesh’s Integrated Clean Energy Policy–2024 and its clean-energy targets, consider the following statements:

1. Projects under the policy include pumped storage and solar ingot-wafer manufacturing at Anakapalli.
2. Andhra Pradesh aims for approximately ₹10 lakh crore in investment and more than 160 GW of renewable-energy capacity.
3. Gandikota-II is a solar ingot-wafer manufacturing project at Anakapalli.
mcqs.explanation: Statements 1 and 2 are correct: the policy covers pumped storage and solar ingot-wafer manufacturing at Anakapalli, while the State aims for approximately ₹10 lakh crore investment and more than 160 GW of renewable-energy capacity. Statement 3 is incorrect because Gandikota-II is a 2,250 MW pumped storage project in YSR Kadapa.

mcqs.question: Before the Quantum-Secure Communications Test Bed at SRM University-AP, which facility had been launched on 14 April 2026?
mcqs.explanation: Quantum Computing Reference Facilities were launched on 14 April 2026, before the Quantum-Secure Communications Test Bed. Gandikota-II and solar ingot-wafer manufacturing are clean-energy projects, while the NIELIT Innovation & Skilling Centre is a separate skilling facility.
